description_en: Queries the details of a class by calling GetClassDetail. You can use this operation to query the class status and the IDs of associated resources such as live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard. You can use these IDs to further query the details of the corresponding live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard resources
description_zh: 调用GetClassDetail获取课程详情。可用于查询课程状态，以及相关联的直播，连麦，白板等ID信息。通过这些ID，可进一步查询对应的直播，连麦，白板的详情
name: GetClassDetail

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when the application is created in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the class, which is returned by the CreateClass operation
parameters.help_zh: 课程唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator. The ID can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 操作人用户ID，仅支持英文字母和数字，长度最多36个字符
parameters.name: user_id

Result.description_en: The result returned for the class details query
Result.description_zh: 获取课堂详情的返回结果

ClassId.description_en: The unique identifier of the class
ClassId.title_en: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。
ClassId.title_zh: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。

ConfId.description_en: The co-streaming conference ID. You can use this ID to join an RTC conference and query conference details
ConfId.description_zh: 连麦会议ID。可用于RTC入会，获取会议详情

CreateNickname.description_en: The nickname of the creator. The nickname can contain Chinese and English characters and is up to 32 characters in length
CreateNickname.description_zh: 创建人用户昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符

CreateUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator. The ID can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
CreateUserId.description_zh: 创建人用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符

EndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the class ended. Unit: milliseconds

LiveId.description_en: The live streaming ID. You can use this ID to query live streaming details and pass it as a parameter when calling live streaming-related operations on the client
LiveId.description_zh: 直播ID。可用于查询直播详情，和端上调用直播相关接口时作为参数传入

RoomId.description_en: The room ID. You can use this ID to query room details and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the client SDK
RoomId.description_zh: 房间ID。可用于查询房间详情信息，和端上SDK接入时作为参数传入

StartTime.description_en: The timestamp when the class started. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 开始上课时间戳，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The class status. Valid values:
0: Not started.
1: In progress.
2: Ended
Status.description_zh:
课程状态。取值：
0：未开始
1：上课中
2：已下课
Status.title_en: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。
Status.title_zh: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。

Title.description_en: The title of the class. The title can contain Chinese and English characters and is up to 32 characters in length
Title.description_zh: 课程标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符

WhiteboardId.description_en: The whiteboard ID. You can use this ID to query whiteboard information and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the whiteboard SDK on the client
WhiteboardId.description_zh: 白板ID。可用于查询白板信息，和端上接入白板SDK时作为参数传入

WhiteboardRecordId.description_en: The whiteboard recording ID. You can use this ID to retrieve and play back whiteboard recording content on the client
WhiteboardRecordId.description_zh: 白板录制ID。可用于端上获取白板录制内容并播放

Result.title_en: API请求的返回结果结构体。
Result.title_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体。
